name: World from Motion (arXiv 2607.01202)
license: not released; paper says 'standard academic license that restricts misuse' is planned
gpu: teacher training 32x GB200 for ~48 h; per-scene re-optimisation ~40 min per 400-frame sequence on 1x A100 (paper)
role: Reference design for the generative loop: render 4D buffers (RGB, opacity, depth, normals, scene flow) along input and virtual trajectories, repair with a fine-tuned Wan 2.1 14B, distill back into one dynamic 3DGS
notes: Stanford + NVIDIA, submitted 2026-07-01. Starts from Shape of Motion / MoSca / WorldTree reconstructions. Gains plateau at ~8 virtual cameras. Stated failure modes: fails if the initial reconstruction fails; struggles with fluids/smoke and extreme viewpoint shifts. No code to run today.

name: 4DGS-Fixer (arXiv 2609.21176)
license: no code; depends on MVSAnywhere (Niantic, non-commercial) and CogVideoV2V
gpu: not stated; authors call the refinement stage computationally expensive
role: Reference design: dense multi-view-depth initialisation, then video-restoration of novel-trajectory renders used as iterative pseudo-supervision
notes: Submitted 2026-09-18 (v2 2026-09-21). Evaluated on Neural3DV with 4 synchronized cameras, 24.18 dB vs 22.29 dB prior best. Backbone STGS. Setting is synchronized sparse multi-view, which is closer to our stationary-clip rig than monocular methods are.

name: NeoVerse (CVPR 2026, arXiv 2601.00393)
license: code Apache-2.0; HF card Apache-2.0; base Wan 2.1 Apache-2.0; the bundled reconstructor is WorldMirror-based (Tencent HunyuanWorld-Mirror Community License, excludes EU/UK/South Korea)
gpu: ~47 GB allocated / ~74 GB peak; --low_vram peak ~38 GB (README). 81 frames at 336x560 by default
role: The runnable generative teacher: renderer-conditioned (RGB, depth, mask, Plucker) Wan 2.1 14B control branch that repaints holes in novel-trajectory renders
notes: Last push 2026-05-12. Training scripts released (ZeRO-2). Use only the video model, fed by our own reconstruction renders, so the Tencent-licensed reconstructor is not in the chain. Output resolution is low: pseudo-views can add coverage, never fine detail.

name: 4DGS-WAM (arXiv 2608.25956)
gpu: small transformers (96-128 dim); not a bottleneck
role: Concept: static background reused as persistent state; model predicts per-object SE(3) twists for dynamic objects only
notes: Submitted 2026-08-26, marked work in progress. KITTI-MOT, horizons of 1 and 3 frames only; assumes no collisions and cannot spawn new objects. The layer separation is right; the model is not usable for indefinite animation.

name: GenMOJO (CVPR 2025)
license: MIT, but ships the Inria gaussian-splatting licence (research/evaluation only) for its rasterizer
role: Object-centric 4D generation of occluded multi-object scenes from in-the-wild video
notes: Last push 2025-08-17. Relevant for people/animals later, not for the natural-site pilot.

name: PhysGaussian (CVPR 2024)
license: no LICENSE file in repo; depends on Inria gaussian-splatting (non-commercial)
role: MPM simulation directly on Gaussian kernels (elastic, metal, sand, fluids)
notes: Last push 2025-04-06. Needs hand-set material parameters; MPM per frame is an offline cost, not a runtime model. Wrong tool for wind-driven vegetation at site scale.

name: PhysFlow (CVPR 2025)
role: Infers material parameters for MPM via multimodal LLM + video diffusion
notes: Last push 2025-07-28, 4 commits. Object-scale interaction demos; no site-scale or wind use.

name: Physics-Informed Deformable GS / PIDG (AAAI 2026, arXiv 2511.06299)
license: no LICENSE file in repo; rasterizer is a fork of the Inria diff-gaussian-rasterization
role: Per-Gaussian time-varying constitutive parameters with Cauchy-momentum residual and optical-flow matching
notes: Last push 2026-02-26. Useful as a research baseline for the stream; not a runtime representation and not licensable as-is.

name: Cesium 3D Gaussian splats with hierarchical LOD (blog 2026-04-27)
license: CesiumJS Apache-2.0; Cesium ion tiling is a paid service
role: Planet-scale delivery of static splats: 3D Tiles + KHR_gaussian_splatting + SPZ with hierarchical LOD
notes: Static only: no animation or time-dynamic splats mentioned. The repo runs CesiumJS 1.145; 1.146 (2026-10-01) adds no splat features. customShader does not reach splats (ADR 0006).

name: KHR_gaussian_splatting (glTF extension)
role: Static splat payload inside 3D Tiles; SPZ compression via KHR_gaussian_splatting_compression_spz_2
notes: README status: Complete, ratified. No provisions for skinning, morph targets or time-varying attributes, so motion must travel as a sidecar.

name: gsplat
gpu: CUDA; single L4/L40S/A100 for a site (runtime unmeasured here)
role: Static canonical layer trainer and the distillation engine; has MCMC strategy, appearance optimisation and bilateral-grid post-processing
notes: Last push 2026-09-19. Already the repo's `train: gsplat` impl (unproven: never run). Shape of Motion and SpotLessSplats build on it, so the whole core stays Apache/MIT.

name: Shape of Motion (ICCV 2025, arXiv 2407.13764)
role: Observed-motion reconstruction: each Gaussian's motion is a weighted blend of a small set of SE(3) motion bases, which is also the runtime motion format we want
notes: Last push 2025-08-02. Preprocessing: UniDepth/Depth Anything depth, Track-Anything masks, TAPIR/BootsTAPIR tracks (Apache), MegaSaM for custom cameras. Also one of WfM's starting points.

name: MegaSaM
license: Apache-2.0 software, CC-BY for other materials
gpu: CUDA 11.8 / PyTorch 2.0.1 tested; VRAM not stated
role: Camera + consistent video depth for dynamic clips where COLMAP struggles
notes: Last push 2026-01-05. For stationary clips, poses come from registering the first frame into the static COLMAP model instead.

name: MapAnything (Meta)
license: code Apache-2.0; weights facebook/map-anything-apache Apache-2.0 (the default weights are CC-BY-NC)
gpu: up to 2000 views on 140 GB in memory-efficient mode
role: Metric dense initialisation and depth priors that can take our calibration, poses and depth as inputs
notes: Last push 2026-08-07. Commercial-safe replacement for MVSAnywhere in a 4DGS-Fixer-style dense init; must use the -apache weights.

name: Depth Anything 3
license: code Apache-2.0; DA3METRIC-LARGE, DA3MONO-LARGE, BASE, SMALL Apache-2.0; LARGE, GIANT, NESTED CC-BY-NC-4.0
role: Monocular/multi-view depth priors for dynamic reconstruction (WfM uses DAv3)
notes: Use only the Apache sizes for anything that ships.

name: VGGT
license: original checkpoint non-commercial; VGGT-1B-Commercial gated by application
gpu: May 2026 fix: 2-3x more frames per GPU budget
role: Feed-forward poses/depth alternative
notes: MapAnything-apache covers the same need without a gate.

name: Wan 2.1 T2V 14B / Wan 2.2
gpu: 14B parameters; 40-80 GB class GPU in practice (via NeoVerse figures)
role: Base video prior under NeoVerse and World from Motion
notes: The licence-clean foundation for any renderer-conditioned fixer we fine-tune ourselves.

name: Difix3D+ (NVIDIA)
license: NVIDIA License, non-commercial (research or evaluation only) + Stability sd-turbo terms
role: Single-image artifact fixer for static 3DGS novel views, distilled back via gsplat
notes: Good A/B baseline for the static layer; cannot ship.

name: GEN3C (NVIDIA)
license: code Apache-2.0; weights NVIDIA Open Model License (commercial use permitted by the licence text, with guardrail/litigation termination clauses)
gpu: ~43 GB with full offloading; tested on A100/H100
role: 3D-cache-conditioned video generation; alternative teacher to NeoVerse, supports dynamic video input via ViPE
notes: Last push 2026-06-15. README points commercial users to NVIDIA Research licensing even though the OML grant itself allows commercial use: get legal sign-off.

name: SAM 2.1
role: Per-frame masks lifted to Gaussians for phenomenon classes (tree, grass, water, rock, transient)
notes: SAM 3 is gated under a custom licence; not needed.

name: TAPIR / BootsTAPIR (tapnet)
role: 2D point tracks for Shape of Motion and for motion-spectrum evaluation
notes: Last push 2026-09-15. Prefer over CoTracker3 (CC-BY-NC).

name: CoTracker3
role: Point tracking
notes: Non-commercial; tapnet covers the need.

name: MVSAnywhere (Niantic)
role: Multi-view depth used by 4DGS-Fixer's dense init
notes: Replace with MapAnything-apache.

name: SpotLessSplats
role: Transient/distractor masking for the static layer; fills the repo's `mask: sls` slot
notes: Complements SAM2 class masks: classes say what may move, SLS catches what did (walkers, cars).

name: COLMAP / GLOMAP
role: Poses for all passes; model_aligner to RTK/GCPs
notes: COLMAP is the repo's verified `pose` impl; `glomap` is a stub. For ~1-2k frames use vocab-tree matching, not exhaustive.

name: Wind on Trees (arXiv 2609.17810)
role: Evidence for the vegetation decision: a damped-oscillator-per-part prior extrapolates beyond the training window and wind far better than learned deformation, at some in-distribution fidelity cost
notes: Submitted 2026-09-15, synthetic trees only. Warning inside: frequency recovered only on the sparsest tree and damping not recovered at all from monocular video, because motion along the view ray is unobservable. Hence synchronized multi-camera clips + anemometer.

name: DynamicTree (arXiv 2510.22213)
role: Feed-forward tree motion via sparse voxel spectrum + modal analysis on 3DGS trees
notes: Project page says code is out; the repo README (last push 2025-12-02) still lists code and the 4DTree dataset as TODO.

name: PhysDreamer (ECCV 2024)
role: Distils video-model dynamics priors into material fields for elastic objects (flowers, plants)
notes: Last push 2025-02-10. Object-scale; interaction, not wind.

name: Generative Image Dynamics (arXiv 2309.07906)
role: Concept: oscillatory natural motion as a frequency-domain spectral volume (image-space modal bases), which loops seamlessly
notes: We apply the same idea in 3D: fit per-node spectra from observed trajectories and resynthesize with random phases.

name: Vid2Fluid (arXiv 2503.00868)
role: Concept for the stream: surface velocity from optical flow, then a divergence-free grid velocity field
notes: Single-view fluid assets; our version uses 2-3 synchronized views and a float-test ground truth.

name: Video Textures (Schodl et al., SIGGRAPH 2000)
role: Non-looping playback of stochastic appearance (water surface) by jumping between similar frames
notes: Classic, cheap, and grounded in the captured frames.

name: Tessendorf, Simulating Ocean Water (FFT)
role: Ocean wave height field for later coastal sites
notes: Not in the pilot; learned residual appearance on top later.

name: splat-transform (PlayCanvas)
role: Format conversion (PLY/SPZ/SOG/GLB) and a working LOD builder (Streamed SOG) to crib from for our own 3D Tiles LOD tiler
notes: Last push 2026-09-22. Its LOD output is PlayCanvas Streamed SOG, not 3D Tiles.

name: SPZ (Niantic)
role: Splat compression inside KHR_gaussian_splatting_compression_spz_2
notes: Already used by tools/captures/splat_tiles.py.

name: Spark (World Labs)
role: three.js splat renderer with per-splat dynamic edits and skeletal animation; reference for a GPU motion hook
notes: Last push 2026-09-22. Not a globe; useful as an offline motion-preview tool and as prior art for a Cesium engine patch.

name: 3DGS-PLY-3DTiles-Converter
role: Open-source PLY to 3D Tiles tiler with LOD and SPZ GLB output
notes: Described by a Khronos forum post (2026-05-10) and a blog (2026-05-19), but the repo was not reachable on 2026-09-23 (web 404; git asks for credentials, so it is private or gone). The sibling renderer plugin repo is reachable.

name: SUMO
role: Traffic agents on OSM roads for vehicle layers (post-pilot)
notes: Runtime vehicles are Cesium glTF models on sampled trajectories, which CesiumJS supports today.

name: DyCheck protocol (NeurIPS 2022, arXiv 2210.13445)
role: Co-visibility-masked metrics and effective multi-view factor; the evaluation discipline for held-out views
notes: Shows 1-2 dB of reported gains came from leaked multi-view signal; our holdout contract prevents the same leak.

name: Twin living-survey stack (packages/world, SplatDeformer, skeleton.py)
gpu: CPU per frame: 1.7 ms for 12k splats, 5.0 ms for 150k (Node, not a browser)
role: Existing runtime: immutable canonical + per-frame texture rewrite, resonant modes, gust field, flutter; skeleton extraction
notes: Proven on a synthetic tree only; refuses multi-tile tilesets; stiffness and wind scale invented. This architecture replaces invented constants with fitted ones and extends it to soft-skinned motion bases.

name: MoSca
role: Alternative monocular dynamic reconstruction (a WfM starting point)
notes: The guessed repo URL returned 404; not located. Shape of Motion fills the role.

name: Cosmos-Predict2.5 (NVIDIA)
license: 'other' on HF; card gated and not readable from here (UNVERIFIED)
role: Possible alternative video prior
notes: Listed only so nobody assumes it was evaluated.
